run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the number occurring an odd number of times in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple arrays to verify it returns the correct odd-occurrence number
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use XOR or a hash map instead of the O(n squared) brute force approach

summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold a function that finds the element appearing an odd number of times in an array
